scope: New immutable development covers, same frozen mechanical arms/parameters as matched-archive-v1. Only public-dictionary arms are resource-feasible without a new candidate-model stage; original/fixed cells explicitly blocked.

prior_information.scope_of_freeze: Analysis choices before encoding new covers; observed ordinary prefix at execution freeze must be recorded exactly in execution manifest, potentially greater than8.

cover_cohort.input: explicit immutable completed batch after-snapshot plus complete300 checkpoint, never live runs
cover_cohort.milestone: May evaluate a completed first30/100 TinyLlama prefix while preserving remaining rows as cover_not_attempted; output eligibility never changes cover selection.
cover_cohort.reuse_completed_rows: Later cumulative milestones reuse exact prior keyed analysis rows by input hash; no duplicate inference, replacement, rerun or fabricated extra observation.

payloads.assignment: All3 inherited lengths per source. At each length sort100 archived luna_missing member paths lexicographically and map nth payload to nth frozen development source; all3 models share the same payload for that source and length.
payloads.secondary: first16 bits of EACH primary payload; retain parent_payload_length, even if16-bit values coincide; no original arm in secondary
payloads.change_from_old_assignment: Old375 archival records each carried one archived message; new covers have no embedded original message. Fully crossed3length grid is an explicit new data assignment, never presented as identical375 design.

original.missing: No author-compatible LLM-generated per-cover candidate table. Historical original_archived replay also required stored encoded_message and payload-shortened key; new covers have neither.
original.nominal_candidate_builder_settings: Must be frozen separately if activated: historical luna b5/a0 versus qwen b3/a0 are not automatically mapped to these3new cover generators.
original.activation: Not authorized by this protocol; requires separately reviewed candidate-stage/version/provider freeze. Do not fabricate a zero-capacity result or silently substitute public WordNet dictionary.

fixed_common.missing: Frozen per-cover candidate values; cannot call candidates_from_legacy_key without absent new-cover key.

statuses.numeric_missing_policy: For missing/blocked cells use null for capacity/delivered bits/book bytes; never zero or insufficient_capacity. Executed insufficient_capacity has delivered0 and retained requested length; zero capacity is preserved explicitly.

independent_axes.precedence: If cover_status is not completed, execution_status=not_run_cover_unavailable. Otherwise if resource_status is blocked, execution_status=not_run_resource_blocked. Always retain both independent input-status axes, so blocked resource counts are not hidden by missing covers.
independent_axes.planned_resource_counts: Original900+fixed7200=8100 cells have blocked resources across all300 regardless of cover availability; only four public arms can become ready after whole-run resource validation.
independent_axes.public_resource_restore_failure: Abort before executing cells if any pinned public implementation/resource/runtime fails validation; never silently reduce available arms.

receiver.public: Fresh subprocess receives only stego bytes, declared public32-byte fixture key, pinned dictionary and Protocol; no cover, requested payload or sender traces.
receiver.fixed_and_original: Not executed until missing per-cover resources exist under separate candidate freeze.
receiver.check: Exact full byte payload equality/length outside receiver by evaluator; independent decoder/checker, complete source/output/hash/row counts.

resource_accounting.native_framing: Keep inherited16/32/144-bit contracts distinct. Actual public overhead via frozen Protocol.frame_overhead_bits; identifiers/transport packaging separately itemized.
resource_accounting.codebook_bytes: null for blocked original/fixed, never zero
resource_accounting.costs: Public stage stdlib/cryptography only. Original candidate model calls, token usage/time/retries are separate costs and are not covered by ordinary generation timing.

restore_policy: Fetch exact immutable Git refs and verify SHA256 before use. Missing destinations may be restored; existing differing files cause refusal. Never edit frozen codecs/protocol/results. Verify full ZIP or its Git chunk manifest; no secret lookup.
implementation_plan: Write a new thin immutable-snapshot runner, not edits to run_matched_archive_v1.py (it hardcodes375 archival replay).
Validate exact config, payload map, resource/source hashes, environment and all300record IDs; create full15300 state grid before any encoder call.
Emit blocked original/fixed rows with null metrics. Run only four frozen public variants on available covers at128/256/512 and corresponding16-bit prefixes; preserve every zero/refusal/error.
Fresh-process receiver and independent oracle check every executed row; package full traces and metrics with source identities; exclusive milestone output and remote Git readback.

Synthetic fixtures verify missing versus zero/insufficient, complete300/15300 counts, payload map, immutability, no-clobber and fresh receiver. Git-freeze implementation/runtime before actual new-cover encoding.
